definitions.explanation: Something placed over or around an object to protect, conceal, or enclose it. Can refer to physical covers like lids, tarps, or protective wrappings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Put a cover on the pot.
Under the blanket of snow, flower buds were quietly waiting for spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされない→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{植木|うえき}→植木：04001_ueki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ビニール→ビニール：11140_biniiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I put a vinyl cover over the potted plant so it wouldn't blow away in the strong wind.

notes:
Noun form derived from the verb ⟦{覆|おお}う→覆う：02020_oou⟧ (to cover). Refers to any material placed over something to protect, conceal, or enclose it — such as a tarp, cloth, or protective wrapping.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put a cover on
- {覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove a cover
- {覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off a cover
- {覆|おお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cover something

USAGE:
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覆|おお}い (blanket of snow), ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覆|おお}い (veil of darkness) — used poetically for anything that covers broadly.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蓋|ふた}→蓋：03896_futa⟧: lid (specifically for containers with openings)
- ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: cover (loanword — book covers, phone cases, etc.)
- ⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: sheet, tarp (practical covering material)
